faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DDA Young Professional (Communications) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the DDA Young Professional (Communications) post is 17th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional (Communications) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree from a recognized university. Preferably, experience in using Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools and a minimum of two years in relevant fields like Mass Communication, Journalism, or Public Relations is also desired.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this DDA recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional (Communications) position is 35 years. There are no specific minimum age limits mentioned for this role.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Young Professional (Communications) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment involves two main stages: shortlisting of applications followed by an interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this DDA recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this DDA Young Professional (Communications) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional (Communications) position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 65,000/- per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The position of Young Professional (Communications) is on a contractual basis with the Delhi Development Authority (DDA).

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email. They should prepare their application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this DDA Young Professional (Communications) recruitment is 07/Consultant/2026/Rectt. Cell/Pers./DDA.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.
